notes.title: HOW TO SHOOT A CRIMINAL IS RELEASED
notes.content:
Hi folks, 
Team Pandorica is proud to present "How to Shoot a Criminal"! It is ready for your viewing and playing pleasure.
There's a 20% launch discount on the price for the first week, take advantage of it!
We hope you will enjoy the game, and if we become instant millionaires, we'll make many more to follow :)
